claims.readme_quote: When every claim is true it says "All 8 claims are true."
setup: Open https://velu2k03.github.io/readme-lie-detector/ in a fresh browser tab with no prior state
Wait for the report page to finish loading
claims.action: Look at the verdict banner at the top of the report page
assertions: A verdict banner is visible at the top of the page
The banner text reads "All 8 claims are true."
claims.store_what: The exact text shown in the verdict banner at the top of the report

claims.readme_quote: `demo-app/` is Hati, a small bill splitter whose README makes eight testable claims. All eight pass.
setup: Open https://velu2k03.github.io/readme-lie-detector/ in a fresh browser tab with no prior state
Wait for the report page to finish loading
claims.action: Scroll through the report and count the claim cards, each of which shows a verdict
assertions: Each claim card shows a verdict
claims.store_what: The number of claim cards on the report page, as a digit

claims.readme_quote: Each claim has its own card showing the README line, the README quote, the value the README expected, the value Kane observed, and the screenshots from every step.
setup: Open https://velu2k03.github.io/readme-lie-detector/ in a fresh browser tab with no prior state
Wait for the report page to finish loading
claims.action: Look at the first claim card on the page, reading its labelled fields
assertions: The card shows a README line number
The card shows the README quote, the expected value and the observed value
The card shows at least one screenshot image
claims.store_what: The visible label or heading on the first claim card that introduces the README quote text

setup: Open https://velu2k03.github.io/readme-lie-detector/ in a fresh browser tab with no prior state
claims.action: Wait for the page to load and read the main page title or heading
assertions: The page loads without an error or 404 message
The main heading or title contains "README Lie Detector"
claims.store_what: The main heading or title text shown at the top of the report page
